sentences.en: Not long ago, I found myself in a subterranean labyrinth below the streets of Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 不久前，我发现自己身处华盛顿特区街道下方的一座地下迷宫中。

sentences.en: I'd come in search of clues.
So here we are in Deck 50 in the stacks of the Library of Congress.
sentences.zh: 我们现在位于国会图书馆书库的50号架区。

sentences.en: I'm opening a door that's marked Door 20.
sentences.zh: 我正在打开一扇标着“20号门”的门。

sentences.en: My guide is a tall, shaggy man named Steve Winnick.
sentences.zh: 我的向导是一位名叫史蒂夫·温尼克的高个子、毛发浓密的男士。

sentences.en: He looks a lot like Hagrid from Harry Potter, which seems about right for somebody with a title of folkloriSt.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很像《哈利·波特》里的海格，对于一个头衔是“民俗学家”的人来说，这倒挺合适。

sentences.en: Steve has already led me through a maze of low-ceiling stacks, across a small bridge,
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫已经带我穿过了一片低矮书架组成的迷宫，跨过了一座小桥，

sentences.en: and into a tiny elevator where the floor numbers go up as we go down.
sentences.zh: 走进了一部小电梯，电梯里的楼层数字随着我们下降而增加。

sentences.en: And in here, we find row upon row of collection boxes on the shelves.
sentences.zh: 在这里，我们看到书架上摆放着一排又一排的收藏盒。

sentences.en: And I'm looking for this collection, which is numbered AFC 1979-008.
sentences.zh: 我正在寻找这个编号为AFC 1979-008的收藏系列。

sentences.en: Steve pulls from the shelf a cardboard box.
sentences.zh: 史蒂夫从架子上取下一个纸板箱。

sentences.en: Nobody's really used this collection very much.
sentences.zh: 几乎没人怎么用过这个收藏系列。

sentences.en: So it's simply, you know, been there waiting for you, really.
sentences.zh: 所以它就一直放在那儿，真的，一直在等你。

sentences.en: The author of this collection is Richard Riley Shepard, a small-time crook and con man who died in 2009.
sentences.zh: 这个收藏系列的作者是理查德·莱利·谢泼德，一个于2009年去世的小骗子和诈骗犯。

sentences.en: I've been tracking Riley Shepard for a few months.
sentences.zh: 我已经追踪莱利·谢泼德几个月了。

sentences.en: My assumption is that there's nothing of significance in the box.
sentences.zh: 我的假设是，这个盒子里没什么重要的东西。

sentences.en: But I'm about to discover that the story I thought I was reporting is not the story I am reporting.
sentences.zh: 但我即将发现，我以为我在报道的故事，并不是我正在报道的故事。

sentences.en: The story that is about to unfold before me is a story of obsession, its power, its beauty, and its costs.
sentences.zh: 即将在我面前展开的故事，是一个关于执念的故事，关于它的力量、它的美，以及它所付出的代价。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we explore the peculiar tale of Riley Shepard,
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，我们将探索莱利·谢泼德那离奇的往事，

sentences.en: a musician and writer who spent decades on a single grand project.
sentences.zh: 他是一位音乐家兼作家，花了数十年时间完成了一个宏大的项目。

sentences.en: Whether that project was a great quest or a great folly, that is for you to decide.
sentences.zh: 那个项目究竟是一场伟大的追求还是一场巨大的愚行，这由你来判断。

sentences.en: He was a genius, I think.
He just was a compulsive liar.
sentences.zh: 他只是个强迫性撒谎者。

sentences.en: He was getting out of town before he was being tart and cut.
sentences.zh: 他还没被抓到之前就想溜之大吉。

sentences.en: No, I haven't got time for that.
I've got to get this done.
So I said, oh shit, man.
I stumbled onto the story as I was contemplating an episode not about obsession, but about fallen heroes.
sentences.zh: 我偶然发现了这个故事，当时我正在构思一期节目，主题不是关于执念，而是关于陨落的英雄。

sentences.en: I'd asked Hidden Brain listeners to share examples from their own lives.
sentences.zh: 我曾请《隐藏的大脑》的听众分享他们生活中的例子。

sentences.en: I hope I did this right.

sentences.zh: ……来自斯塔西娅·谢泼德-西尔弗曼。

sentences.en: She said her fallen hero was her dad, Riley Shepard, whom she still loved.
sentences.zh: 她说她心目中陨落的英雄是她的父亲莱利·谢泼德，她依然爱着他。

sentences.en: I want to say that I had a great relationship with my father.
sentences.zh: 我想说，我和我父亲的关系非常好。

sentences.en: He was totally cool in many ways and a great cook.
sentences.zh: 他在很多方面都很酷，而且是个很棒的厨师。

sentences.en: When we talk, Stacia tells me that as a young girl, she idolized her dad.
sentences.zh: 当我们交谈时，斯塔西娅告诉我，她小时候曾把父亲奉为偶像。

sentences.en: She has memories of those days that feel like tiny, sparkling geMs.
sentences.zh: 她对那些日子的记忆就像一颗颗闪闪发光的小宝石。

sentences.en: My earliest memory of my dad is sitting on his lap and him smoking his cigar, and he would make cigar smoke rings for me.
sentences.zh: 我最早关于父亲的记忆是坐在他膝盖上，他抽着雪茄，为我吐出雪茄烟圈。

sentences.en: Stacia would watch them, transfixed, as they rose in the air before her.
sentences.zh: 斯塔西娅会目不转睛地看着它们在面前升入空中。

sentences.en: I thought the smoke rings were magical.
sentences.zh: 我觉得那些烟圈有魔力。

sentences.en: There was a lot that was magical for Stacia back then.
sentences.zh: 那时候对斯塔西娅来说，有很多东西都充满了魔力。

sentences.en: She still remembers their little apartment in Hollywood, with the Siamese cat and the cat hair and the hardwood floors.
sentences.zh: 她至今还记得他们在好莱坞的小公寓，那只暹罗猫，猫毛，还有硬木地板。

sentences.en: She remembers how much she loved that her dad was around all the time.
sentences.zh: 她记得她有多喜欢父亲一直陪在身边。

sentences.en: He didn't have a regular job, and he would sit in the middle of the living room, usually, wherever we lived, and he would type.
sentences.zh: 他没有正经工作，通常无论我们住在哪里，他都会坐在客厅中央打字。

sentences.en: So he was working on things.
sentences.zh: 所以他一直在忙些什么。

sentences.en: I didn't know what, but I would sit under his desk sometimes while he typed away, and we would talk in between the pages, and he would tell me things about show business.
sentences.zh: 我不知道是什么，但有时我会坐在他的书桌下，听他打字，我们在打字间隙聊天，他会告诉我一些关于演艺圈的事情。

sentences.en: They were in their own little bubble, Riley in his late 50s, and his little daughter, typing, talking, just being together.
sentences.zh: 他们生活在自己的小世界里，年近六旬的莱利和他的小女儿，打字、聊天，只是在一起。

sentences.en: Sometimes, if Riley had a little money, he'd take Stacia out to eat at their favorite Hollywood hotspot, a restaurant called the Brown Derby.
sentences.zh: 有时，如果莱利手头有点钱，他会带斯塔西娅去他们最喜欢的“好莱坞热点”——一家叫“棕色德比”的餐厅吃饭。

sentences.en: It was a place where Riley could rub shoulders with famous people, charm them with his warm Southern accent, and impress his daughter on their way home.
sentences.zh: 在那里，莱利可以和名人打成一片，用他温暖的南方口音吸引他们，并在回家的路上给女儿留下深刻印象。

sentences.en: You know, the Hollywood stars were all around us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，好莱坞明星就在我们周围。

sentences.en: We could walk up the street, and my father would tell me about movie stars when we walked.
sentences.zh: 我们可以走在街上，我父亲会在我们散步时跟我讲电影明星的事。

sentences.en: Stacia was certain that her dad was something of a star himself.
sentences.zh: 斯塔西娅确信她的父亲本身也是个明星。

sentences.en: Sometimes he'd tell her about his musical career as a successful promoter, singer, and songwriter.
sentences.zh: 有时他会告诉她他作为成功的推广人、歌手和词曲作者的音乐生涯。

sentences.en: Occasionally, he might even sing the song.
sentences.zh: 偶尔，他甚至会唱那首歌。
“我将度过一个忧郁的圣诞节”

sentences.en: He told me, and he told everyone, that he wrote the song Blue Christmas.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，也告诉所有人，那首《忧郁的圣诞节》是他写的。

sentences.en: Billy Hayes and Jay Johnson wrote Blue Christmas.
sentences.zh: 比利·海耶斯和杰伊·约翰逊才写了《忧郁的圣诞节》。

sentences.en: The person who made it famous?
sentences.zh: 让这首歌成名的人是谁？

sentences.en: If Riley had written Blue Christmas, money might not have been so tight for the family.
sentences.zh: 如果莱利写了《忧郁的圣诞节》，家里可能就不会那么缺钱了。

sentences.en: I was told constantly that we were artists, and that there were artists, and there were ordinary people, and we were artists.
sentences.zh: 我经常被告知我们是艺术家，世界上有艺术家，也有普通人，而我们是艺术家。

sentences.en: Stacia eventually learned about her dad's most important artistic endeavor, not a song, but a writing project.
sentences.zh: 斯塔西娅最终了解了她父亲最重要的艺术事业，不是一首歌，而是一个写作项目。

sentences.en: The encyclopedia of folk music, and that was supposedly his life's work, and it was vaSt.
sentences.zh: 民俗音乐百科全书，那据说是他毕生的心血，而且规模宏大。

sentences.en: I mean, there were boxes there, huge boxes of volumes of indexes and things he was working on in books.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那里有箱子，巨大的箱子，里面装满了索引卷和他在书中研究的东西。

sentences.en: To fund its creation, Riley solicited money from investors, some of whom he convinced to pour thousands of dollars into the project.
sentences.zh: 为了资助它的创作，莱利向投资者筹集资金，其中一些人被他说服，向该项目投入了数千美元。

sentences.en: Sometimes investors and bill collectors would call to ask when they were going to get paid.
sentences.zh: 有时投资者和收债人会打电话来问他们什么时候能拿到钱。

sentences.en: He used to get on the phone with all kinds of people and say, you didn't get the check?
sentences.zh: 他过去常在电话里跟各种人说，你们没收到支票吗？

sentences.en: He would constantly rail against the post office.
So as a little girl, I also became very militant against the post office.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个小女孩，我也变得非常敌视邮局。

sentences.en: I also would rail against the post office, and if I had a pen pal or a friend that I was writing a letter to, I'd always write on the outside of the envelope.
sentences.zh: 我也会抱怨邮局，如果我有笔友或朋友要写信，我总会在信封外面写上。

sentences.en: You know, I was like enraged with the post office that they wouldn't deliver letters,
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时对邮局不投递信件感到非常愤怒，

sentences.en: because I just thought they're constantly throwing my dad under the bus and not mailing his checks.
sentences.zh: 因为我以为他们一直在陷害我父亲，不寄他的支票。

sentences.en: For many children, there is a moment when a curtain pulls back and parents are revealed for who they are,
sentences.zh: 对于许多孩子来说，总有一个时刻，幕布拉开，父母的真面目显露出来，

sentences.en: imperfect beings with flaws and failings.
sentences.zh: 他们是不完美的，有着缺点和过失。

sentences.en: But for Starsha, the father she saw when the curtain opened was hard to recognize.
sentences.zh: 但对斯塔西娅来说，当幕布拉开时，她看到的父亲让她难以辨认。

sentences.en: It happened one day when she was 12, hanging out at home.
sentences.zh: 那发生在一天她12岁的时候，在家里闲逛。

sentences.en: The caller demanded to speak to her dad.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人要求找她父亲。

sentences.en: His voice was shaking, and I could tell he was elderly.
sentences.zh: 他的声音在颤抖，我能听出他上了年纪。

sentences.en: And he just sounded like a mean old man to me.
sentences.zh: 在我听来，他就像个刻薄的老头。

sentences.en: And he told me that my father took his life savings.
sentences.zh: 他告诉我，我父亲骗走了他一生的积蓄。

sentences.en: The phone is in my ear, and he's saying,
sentences.zh: 电话贴在我的耳边，他说着，

sentences.en: In 1946, Riley Shepard released a cover of the hit song,
sentences.zh: 1946年，莱利·谢泼德发行了一首热门歌曲的翻唱版，

sentences.en: It was inspired by the bombings of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.
sentences.zh: 它的灵感来自于广岛和长崎的原子弹爆炸。

sentences.en: Oh, this world is at a tremble with its strength and mighty power.
sentences.zh: 噢，这个世界因其力量和强大的威力而颤抖。

sentences.en: They're sending up to heaven to get the brimstone fire.
sentences.zh: 他们正向天堂送去硫磺之火。
莱利曾是一位冉冉升起的人才。

sentences.en: He had dark, good looks, a soft southern twang, and the guitar skills to make a go of it.
sentences.zh: 他长相英俊，带着南方口音，还有吉他功底，足以让他闯出一番天地。

sentences.en: It was the mighty power of God's own holy hand.
sentences.zh: 那是上帝圣手带来的强大力量。
他与多家唱片公司签约。

sentences.en: It was given by the mighty hand of God.
sentences.zh: 那是上帝的巨手所赐予的。

sentences.en: But Riley Shepard never achieved stardom.
sentences.zh: 但莱利·谢泼德从未成名。

sentences.en: Instead, his life took a series of detours.
sentences.zh: 相反，他的人生经历了一连串的曲折。

sentences.en: Music historian Kevin Coffey tracked Riley down about a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 音乐历史学家凯文·科菲大约十年前找到了莱利。

sentences.en: He would die a year later.
Kevin was interested in preserving the stories of old-time country-western performers.
sentences.zh: 凯文对保存老派乡村西部表演者的故事很感兴趣。

sentences.en: He thought Riley might be worth profiling.
The conversation they had over a crackly phone line was friendly and nostalgic and full of insider names most people wouldn't recognize.
sentences.zh: 他们在嘈杂的电话线上进行的谈话友好而怀旧，充满了大多数人认不出的圈内人名字。

sentences.en: Gradually, Kevin pieced together Riley's backstory.
sentences.zh: 渐渐地，凯文拼凑出了莱利的背景故事。

sentences.en: Richard Riley Shepard was born on a farm near Wilmington, North Carolina, in 1918.
sentences.zh: 理查德·莱利·谢泼德于1918年出生在北卡罗来纳州威尔明顿附近的一个农场。

sentences.en: He dropped out of school in the fifth grade and decided to try his luck at singing.
sentences.zh: 他在五年级时辍学，决定去碰碰运气唱歌。

sentences.en: It was a heady time for music in the region.
sentences.zh: 那是该地区音乐发展的鼎盛时期。

sentences.en: Groups like the Mainers Mountaineers were popularizing what was then called hillbilly music.
sentences.zh: 像“梅纳登山民”这样的团体正在推广当时所谓的“乡巴佬音乐”。

sentences.en: Riley started out playing songs in minstrel shows.
sentences.zh: 莱利最初是在吟游诗人表演中演唱歌曲。

sentences.en: Soon, he told Kevin, he was getting gigs with hillbilly groups like the Dixie Reelers.
sentences.zh: 很快，他告诉凯文，他开始和像“迪克西卷轴手”这样的乡巴佬乐队一起演出。

sentences.en: By the early 1940s, Riley had moved to Chicago.
sentences.zh: 到20世纪40年代初，莱利搬到了芝加哥。

sentences.en: He toured with other hillbilly musicians and did comedy and acting work.
sentences.zh: 他与其他乡巴佬音乐家一起巡演，并从事喜剧和表演工作。

sentences.en: He also began cultivating his image as a cowboy crooner.
sentences.zh: 他还开始塑造自己作为牛仔歌手的形象。

sentences.en: As he created this new persona, he gave himself a catchy moniker.
sentences.zh: 在创造这个新角色时，他给自己起了一个朗朗上口的绰号。

sentences.en: Where did you come up with that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么想出那个名字的？

sentences.en: Because I know you were calling yourself the...
sentences.zh: 因为我知道你当时自称是……

sentences.en: I didn't come up with it.
Gene Hawking came up with it.
Because I found an ad from way back in 1945 and you were already using it back then.
sentences.zh: 因为我找到了1945年的一则广告，你当时就已经在用这个名字了。

sentences.en: Gene Hawking came up with that crap.
sentences.zh: 吉恩·霍金想出了那堆废话。

sentences.en: To top off his fancy new title of philosopher, Riley grew a dashing mustache and began scheming
sentences.zh: 为了给他的“哲学家”新头衔锦上添花，莱利留起了一撇时髦的胡子，并开始策划

sentences.en: up fresh ways to get into the spotlight.
sentences.zh: 各种新花样来博取关注。

sentences.en: The Cosmopolitan Church presents Dr. Richard Riley Shepard, P-H-D-D-D.
sentences.zh: 大都会教堂隆重推出理查德·莱利·谢泼德博士，哲学博士。

sentences.en: A few years ago, she found one of the old flyers that advertised her dad's lectures.
sentences.zh: 几年前，她发现了其中一张宣传她父亲讲座的旧传单。

sentences.en: Dr. Richard Riley Shepard, author, historian, world traveler, philosopher, in a series of
sentences.zh: 理查德·莱利·谢泼德博士，作家、历史学家、世界旅行家、哲学家，带来一系列

sentences.en: The world traveler and philosopher was prepared to discuss a variety of important topics.
sentences.zh: 这位世界旅行家兼哲学家准备讨论各种重要议题。

sentences.en: Even as he sought to make a name for himself with his educational lectures, Riley was still
sentences.zh: 即便在试图通过教育讲座来为自己博取名声时，莱利依然

sentences.en: churning out songs at a frenzied pace, often releasing a new record every month.
sentences.zh: 以疯狂的速度炮制歌曲，常常每个月都会发布一张新唱片。

sentences.en: But Kevin says Riley wasn't reliable.
sentences.zh: 但凯文说莱利并不靠谱。

sentences.en: He'd sign with one record label, and while his contract was still in force, he'd sign with
sentences.zh: 他会与一家唱片公司签约，而在合同依然有效期间，他又会与

sentences.en: He'd often use different stage names or pseudonyms with different labels.
sentences.zh: 他经常在不同的唱片公司使用不同的艺名或化名。

sentences.en: Hickey Free was one of the names I used.
sentences.zh: “希基·弗里”是我用过的名字之一。

sentences.en: For a time, Riley was able to make it all work, in part because he did have a little star
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，莱利确实把这一切都搞定了，部分原因是他确实有一点明星

sentences.en: He'd done well with atomic power, and later had another catchy tune titled Cowboy.
sentences.zh: 他在《原子能》这首歌上表现不错，后来又有一首名为《牛仔》的动听曲目。

sentences.en: Riley recorded it under the name Dixon Hall.
sentences.zh: 莱利以“迪克森·霍尔”的名字录制了这首歌。

sentences.en: We looked out the window, and I saw a thing called Hall's Clothing, a big sign.
sentences.zh: 我们看向窗外，我看到一个叫“霍尔服装店”的大招牌。

sentences.en: And then, Art Dixon came in, and so I said, well, Dixon Hall, that sounded okay.
sentences.zh: 然后，阿特·迪克森进来了，所以我说，嗯，迪克森·霍尔，听起来不错。
这就是莱利的行事方式。
他行事随心所欲，不择手段。

sentences.en: He also worked as an agent, getting music labels to sign new artists.
sentences.zh: 他还担任过经纪人，拉拢音乐公司签下新艺人。

sentences.en: You see, I tell him, what do you think a publisher is?
sentences.zh: 你看，我告诉他，你觉得出版商是什么？

sentences.en: He wouldn't know a hit song, could crawl out from under his desk and beat him on the leg.
sentences.zh: 他根本不懂什么是热门歌曲，就算从桌子底下爬出来踢他的腿，他都不知道。

sentences.en: He sold songs to these executives with a combination of bluster and hype.
sentences.zh: 他靠着虚张声势和炒作，把歌曲卖给这些高管。

sentences.en: This role allowed Riley to capitalize on one of his greatest strengths.
sentences.zh: 这个角色让莱利得以利用他最大的优势之一。

sentences.en: He once boasted that he could have started his own religion.
sentences.zh: 他曾吹嘘说自己本可以创立一个宗教。

sentences.en: Read about Sioux City Sioux, which was written by Dick Thomas.
sentences.zh: 读读《苏城苏族人》吧，那是迪克·托马斯写的。

sentences.en: Recorded by him on a small label, and he brought it to me.
sentences.zh: 他用一家小厂牌录制了这首歌，然后带给了我。

sentences.en: And I said, if you do what I tell you, you'll make a lot of money.
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你按我说的做，你会赚大钱的。

sentences.en: I got him $7,000 advance and seven cents a copy.
sentences.zh: 我为他争取到了7000美元的预付款，以及每张唱片7美分的版税。

sentences.en: It's the biggest money ever paid for a Hillbilly song.
sentences.zh: 这是乡村音乐史上支付过的最高金额。

sentences.en: Riley was also a hustler in his personal life, where the consequences of his actions were more serious.
sentences.zh: 莱利在个人生活中也是个骗子，而他行为的后果则更为严重。
玛丽昂·基米尼克对此深有体会。

sentences.en: As an adult, she searched for and found her biological mother.
sentences.zh: 成年后，她寻找并找到了自己的亲生母亲。

sentences.en: From her, Marion learned that her father was Riley Shepard.
sentences.zh: 从她那里，玛丽昂得知她的父亲是莱利·谢泼德。

sentences.en: Marion's mother had met him while working as an actress in Chicago.
sentences.zh: 玛丽昂的母亲是在芝加哥当演员时认识他的。

sentences.en: And she said he was very charming, very good looking.
sentences.zh: 她说他非常有魅力，长得非常帅。

sentences.en: He played the guitar, and he sang.
And I guess she was kind of smitten with him.
sentences.zh: 我想她当时对他有点着迷。

sentences.en: That, she told Marion, wasn't supposed to happen.
sentences.zh: 她告诉玛丽昂，那是不应该发生的。

sentences.en: He told her he was sterile.
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，他没有生育能力。

sentences.en: And from what I understand, he told every woman he was with that he was sterile.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，他告诉每一个和他在一起的女人，他都没有生育能力。

sentences.en: Whatever he'd achieved in the music industry, it was all winding down by the early 1960s.
sentences.zh: 无论他在音乐界取得了什么成就，到20世纪60年代初，一切都在走下坡路。

sentences.en: By then, Riley had picked up and moved on to the West CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 那时，莱利已经收拾行囊搬到了西海岸。

sentences.en: He first went to Oregon, and then to California.
sentences.zh: 他先去了俄勒冈州，然后去了加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: He told Kevin he gave up the music business so he could turn his attention to a new project,
sentences.zh: 他告诉凯文，他放弃了音乐事业，这样他就可以专注于一个新项目，
一部民间音乐百科全书。

sentences.en: But Kevin Thing's years of lying and cheating and breaking contracts had simply caught up with him.
sentences.zh: 但凯文·辛多年来的谎言、欺骗和违约行为终究还是让他付出了代价。

sentences.en: He made it sound like he did these moves for different purposes.
sentences.zh: 他把这些举动说得好像是为了不同的目的。

sentences.en: I think usually he was getting out of town before he was being tart and feathered.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他通常是在被人涂满焦油和羽毛赶出城之前就先溜了。

sentences.en: It's perhaps fitting that the place Riley landed for the next chapter of his life was Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 莱利为他人生的下一篇章选择落脚的地方是好莱坞，这或许很合适。

sentences.en: Tinseltown was shiny and bright, and full of the kind of transformative stories that Riley loved.
sentences.zh: “镀金之城”光鲜亮丽，充满了莱利所钟爱的那种充满变数的故事。

sentences.en: He arrived there with his common-law wife and young daughter, Stasha.
sentences.zh: 他带着他的同居妻子和年幼的女儿斯塔莎来到了那里。

sentences.en: For a while, he thrived in his new role as Riley Shepard, family man.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他以“莱利·谢泼德，顾家男人”的新身份过得风生水起。

sentences.en: But like most things in Riley's life, it didn't laSt.
sentences.zh: 但就像莱利生活中的大多数事情一样，这并没有持续太久。

sentences.en: After all these years, Stasha still fixates on the memory of that old man's telephone call.
sentences.zh: 多年过去了，斯塔莎依然对那个老人的电话记忆犹新。

sentences.en: Stasha says it was a turning point in her relationship with her father.
sentences.zh: 斯塔莎说，那是她与父亲关系的一个转折点。

sentences.en: Right when he walked in the door, I was like, you know, screaming at him,
sentences.zh: 就在他走进门的那一刻，我就像，你知道，对他大喊大叫，

sentences.en: you're a crook, you're a crook.
And he looked at me like he turned white, and he was shocked.
sentences.zh: 他看着我，脸色变得惨白，他被震惊了。

sentences.en: I don't remember the exact words, but I remember he stormed out,
sentences.zh: 我不记得具体的字眼了，但我记得他冲了出去，

sentences.en: and he went out to his car, and he sat there and smoked,
sentences.zh: 他走到车里，坐在那里抽烟，

sentences.en: and he didn't come back inside for a long time.
sentences.zh: 很长一段时间都没有回到屋里。

sentences.en: He would just, that's what he would do when he was mad.
sentences.zh: 他总是这样，生气的时候就会那样做。

sentences.en: He would go out into his car and pout.
But the next morning, Riley did what came naturally to him.
sentences.zh: 但第二天早上，莱利又恢复了本性。

sentences.en: He tried to smooth things over.
He told her the encyclopedia was going to make a lot of money,
sentences.zh: 他告诉她，那部百科全书会赚很多钱，

sentences.en: and that his investors would get paid.
sentences.zh: 他的投资者会拿到钱的。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I loved my dad, and he was very apologetic and sweet,
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，我爱我的爸爸，他非常抱歉，也很贴心，

sentences.en: and you want to believe your parents.
sentences.zh: 你总是想相信你的父母。

sentences.en: And also, he was very good at convincing.
sentences.zh: 而且，他非常擅长说服别人。

sentences.en: Stasha didn't know how much money her dad owed,
sentences.zh: 斯塔莎不知道她父亲欠了多少钱，

sentences.en: but she got the sense he was constantly evading creditors.
sentences.zh: 但她感觉到他一直在躲避债权人。

sentences.en: She tells one story of calling home to get a ride.
sentences.zh: 她讲了一次打电话回家求接送的故事。

sentences.en: And when my dad picked up the phone, he was pretending to be a Chinese man.
sentences.zh: 当我爸爸接起电话时，他在假装是一个中国人。

sentences.en: He was pretending to be, used this accent that, like from Breakfast at Tiffany's,
sentences.zh: 他在假装，用了那种口音，就像《蒂凡尼的早餐》里那样，

sentences.en: that horrible, you know, was that Mickey Rooney?
sentences.zh: 那种可怕的，你知道，是米基·鲁尼演的那个吗？

sentences.en: But I knew it was him.

sentences.zh: 你总是能听出你父亲的声音。

sentences.en: And he was like, hung up on me.
sentences.zh: 然后他就像，挂断了我的电话。

sentences.en: Riley took every shortcut he could to make a buck.
sentences.zh: 莱利为了赚钱，无所不用其极。

sentences.en: For a time, he wrote porn under the pseudonym Zachary Quill.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，他以“扎卡里·奎尔”为笔名写色情小说。

sentences.en: One of his books, Glowing Heat.
Stasha says her mother told her that Riley had worked out a formula.
sentences.zh: 斯塔莎说，她母亲告诉她，莱利总结出了一套公式。

sentences.en: She said, oh, well, Dad used to get all these cheap novels,
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，爸爸以前会买来这些廉价小说，

sentences.en: and then he would write porn scenes,
sentences.zh: 然后他会写一些色情片段，

sentences.en: and he would have typists insert the porn scenes in these crappy novels and resell them.
sentences.zh: 他会让打字员把这些色情片段插入到这些烂小说里，然后转手卖掉。
一切总是乱七八糟，令人困惑。

sentences.en: She remembers another time when they had to flee their house before the landlord came,
sentences.zh: 她记得还有一次，他们在房东来之前不得不逃离住所，

sentences.en: probably because Riley hadn't paid the rent.
sentences.zh: 大概是因为莱利没交房租。

sentences.en: We got in this rickety old truck with all our stuff jammed in it.
sentences.zh: 我们坐进了一辆破旧的卡车，里面塞满了我们的东西。

sentences.en: And my father's Encyclopedia of Folk Music was in there very carefully packed.
sentences.zh: 我父亲的那部《民间音乐百科全书》被非常小心地打包放在里面。

sentences.en: Those were the biggest boxes that we took.
sentences.zh: 那是我们带走的最大箱子。

sentences.en: And all our other stuff was just kind of strewn in this truck,
sentences.zh: 而我们所有的其他东西只是胡乱地堆在卡车里，

sentences.en: and it wasn't very well packed.
And when we were driving down the highway,
sentences.zh: 当我们行驶在高速公路上时，

sentences.en: I remember this, it was so weird.
You know, people were pointing at us and trying to get our attention,
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们指着我们，试图引起我们的注意，

sentences.en: I mean, I remember my mother being like,
sentences.zh: 我是说，我记得我母亲当时说，

sentences.en: wow, why are they waving at us?
sentences.zh: 哇，他们为什么要向我们挥手？

sentences.en: And then realizing, oh, our stuff is flying out.
sentences.zh: 然后才意识到，哦，我们的东西正在飞出去。

sentences.en: Like our slim belongings that we had pared down from selling almost everything else,
sentences.zh: 就像我们卖掉几乎所有东西后剩下的那点微薄的家当，

sentences.en: Not the Encyclopedia of Folk Music,
sentences.zh: 不是《民间音乐百科全书》，

sentences.en: but my clothes and what few things.
sentences.zh: 而是我的衣服和仅剩的几件东西。

sentences.en: the family had settled in Porterville, California,
sentences.zh: 一家人定居在加利福尼亚州的波特维尔，

sentences.en: a town on the western edge of the Sierra Nevada mountains.
sentences.zh: 一个位于内华达山脉西缘的小镇。

sentences.en: Riley spent his days working on his encyclopedia,
sentences.zh: 莱利每天都在忙着写他的百科全书，
他是在尽可能地诈骗所有人。

sentences.en: It all ended when Stascha was 18.
sentences.zh: 这一切在斯塔莎18岁时结束了。

sentences.zh: 莱利·谢泼德做了他以前做过很多次的事情。

sentences.zh: 和他在一起生活了23年的那个人，

sentences.zh: 说他要去洛杉矶短途旅行。

sentences.en: But when she woke up in the morning,
she realized that he had taken way more than what you would need for a short trip.
sentences.zh: 她意识到他带走的东西远不止短途旅行所需。

sentences.en: And he never came, he did not come back.
sentences.zh: 他再也没有回来，他没有回来。

sentences.en: Stascha had no idea where he was.
sentences.zh: 斯塔莎根本不知道他在哪里。

sentences.en: Eventually, she found him living about an hour away in Fresno.
sentences.zh: 最终，她发现他住在离那儿大约一小时路程的弗雷斯诺。

sentences.en: He glamorized the life of being a grifter.
He glamorized the life of being a conman.

sentences.zh: 斯塔莎在对莱利行为的厌恶

sentences.en: and her love for the dad who made her smoke rings
and took her to the Brown Derby.
sentences.zh: 带她去布朗德比餐厅的父亲的爱之间感到挣扎。
斯塔莎离开了波特维尔。

sentences.en: and played the role of the old cowboy musician.
sentences.zh: 扮演起老牛仔音乐人的角色。
